contexts.raw:
s01 | Mero method notes
Method A runs without a network when the entire requested catalog was cached before departure. It cannot fetch uncached records offline. Method B requires a live network for every lookup.

s02 | Vela version 1 note
Method A version 1 exports PNG with a transparent background. This note applies only to version 1.

s03 | Vela version 2 note
In version 2, Method A exports opaque PNG only. Method B version 2 exports transparent PNG. These are the current version 2 capabilities.

s04 | Pavo drawing export
Method A produces flat RGB drawings. It does not contain depth data. Method B also produces flat RGB drawings and explicitly does not support depth maps. Method A supports SVG output; Method B exports PNG only.

s05 | Neri storage comparison
Method A compresses daily archives to save storage. Method B keeps the uncompressed original. Neither note reports data about encryption or latency. Compression ratio for Method A was measured on daily archives, not on live streams.

s06 | Runa test team one
Under workload W with version 3, Method A has a worst-case latency of 20 milliseconds. Method B has a worst-case latency of 90 milliseconds.

s07 | Runa test team two
Under the same workload W with version 3, Method A has a worst-case latency of 80 milliseconds. Method B has a worst-case latency of 90 milliseconds. There is no adjudication between the two teams' reports.

s08 | Tavi deployment guide
Method A must run in a cloud service and sends source documents to that service. Method B can run locally without network access. Method B requires at least 8 GB of available RAM. Method A is not available for local deployment.
